instruction: The CMS page with URL key `service-hours-draft` is difficult to scan. Simplify it without changing its meaning: set the title and content heading to `Service Hours`, replace the body with three short lines in this order—`Monday-Friday: 9 AM-5 PM`, `Saturday: 10 AM-2 PM`, `Sunday: Closed`—enable the page, and save it. Use username `admin` and password `admin1234`.
gt_steps: Sign in to the CMS admin site.
Set the page title to `Service Hours`.
Set the content heading to `Service Hours`.

Replace the existing body with `Monday-Friday: 9 AM-5 PM
Saturday: 10 AM-2 PM
Sunday: Closed`, one item per line and in that order.

page.title: Service availability information
page.content: Our representatives generally answer enquiries during ordinary weekday business hours, with a shorter service period available on Saturdays; the desk does not operate on Sundays.
